## Butler has been revived!

Again! Don't kill Butler!!

## New

- **Added creating bots!** With a draft option, so you don't lose your progress.
- **Editing your profile bio** has been added!
- **You can pick a different model to summarize your chats!** Settings › Model.
- **Added cloudflare check.**
- **Many bug fixes!**

## Install

Grab **Butler-0.4.4.apk** for your phone: it installs over any earlier version and keeps your chats and settings. **Butler-0.4.4.msi** is for Windows 10 and 11, and installs just for you, no admin needed.
